question: Do served meals in upland boarding schools match the published menus and cost sheets, and how common are cut rations?
why_it_matters: Every finding here rests on plans and purchase sheets from schools that publish; the Hoang Thu Pho 1 case shows rations can be cut; if many kitchens serve thin meals, the zinc and extender cases change
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask three provincial DOETs (Dien Bien, Lai Chau, Lao Cai) for their 2025 to 2026 bán trú inspection summaries; or a one-week plate and ledger check in five schools
owner_org_to_ask: Provincial Departments of Education and Training (Dien Bien, Lai Chau, Lao Cai); MOET Department of Students

question: How many pupils receive Decree 66/2025 food support and Decree 188/2026 boarding support in 2026 to 2027, and what is the total food budget?
why_it_matters: Sizes the upland school kitchen channel, which buys mostly pork; only the Decree 339 count (417,708) was found
cheapest_way_to_close: Written request to MOET and the Ministry of Finance, or the 2027 budget estimate annex
owner_org_to_ask: MOET Department of Ethnic Minority Education; Ministry of Finance

question: What do upland boarding breakfasts supply in protein, zinc, calcium and vitamin A?
why_it_matters: 86% of breakfasts carry little or no animal food; breakfast, not lunch, is where a cheap fortified plant item could fill a gap
cheapest_way_to_close: One weighed breakfast survey in two boarding schools, or ask NIN whether its school surveys cover breakfast
owner_org_to_ask: National Institute of Nutrition; Thai Nguyen University of Medicine and Pharmacy (authors of UPL-18)

question: Would upland school kitchens use a textured-soy pork extender in braised pork-and-tofu dishes, at what price, and can their local suppliers provide one with the required documents?
why_it_matters: Kitchens already replace about a third of the pork with tofu on two lunches in five; a cheaper extender would displace pork under fixed per-pupil budgets
cheapest_way_to_close: Three calls to kitchen managers at Muong Nhe, Leng Su Sin and Ta Ngao, and one to a commune food supplier
owner_org_to_ask: School kitchen managers; commune food suppliers

question: What do the VGCL's 30 model shift-meal menus contain (species, plant slot, grams)?
why_it_matters: They are the union's reference for canteen menus; a plant or blended dish in them would open the canteen route through collective bargaining
cheapest_way_to_close: Email request to the VGCL Labour Relations Department and the Institute of Occupational Safety and Health
owner_org_to_ask: Vietnam General Confederation of Labour; Institute of Occupational Safety and Health

question: What species mix and grams do industrial caterers actually serve (served menus, not marketing samples)?
why_it_matters: The canteen animals-per-meal figure (0.010 to 0.029) and the fish share (26%) come from sample menus
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask three caterers (Haseca, Hoang Kim, one Hai Phong caterer) for one month of served menus with grams
